answer: An operator copying one text across 114 aliases therefore pays for 114 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the sable hash is stored at intake, the umber graph groups the endorsements and the zenith audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
